storyCards.fact:
Cure's "Boys Don't Cry" — original release 1979. "Boys Don't Cry" is a song by English rock band the Cure.

Artist: Cure · Title: Boys Don't Cry · Album: The Cure - Curaids · Year: 1985 · Genre: Rock · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/1980's/Cure - Boys Don't Cry.mp4.

/Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/1990's/The Cure - Boys Don t Cry (MTV Unplugged).mp4 · Performance: MTV Unplugged.

It was released in the UK as a stand-alone single on 12 June 1979, and was included as the title track on Boys Don't Cry, the American equivalent to Three Imaginary Boys.
